rv.q: It pulls you irrepressibly in with its rousing message that life is not for regret but for kindness, gratitude – and most of all for living.
Even more curiously, this was the narrative basis of what could well be one of the best new British musicals of recent years.
Wistful, moving new musical based on Rachel Joyce’s novel of grief, hope and hiking
